followerRange.description: Raw follower count range in min-max format. Example: 1000-2000 means 1,000 to 2,000 followers; 5000000-10000000 means 5 million to 10 million followers.

kolPriceRange.description: Creator quote range in min-max format (e.g., 10000-50000). Requires kolPriceType; omit kolPriceRange to use the full range for the selected quote type.

viralRateRange.description: Viral content rate range in decimal min-max format. Page presets include 0-0.1, 0.1-0.25, 0.25-0.5, 0.5-0.99, and 0.99 or above. For open-ended presets, pass a high upper bound such as 0.99-1. Example: 0.1-0.25.

isCuratedAuthor.description: Whether to include only Xingtu curated creators under Topic Recommendations.

marketingTarget.description: Marketing goal. Available values: BRAND_EXPOSURE/1/品牌曝光, CIRCLE_SEEDING/2/破圈种草, ACTION_CONVERSION/3/行动转化.

expectedCpeRange.description: Expected CPE range in min-max format. Example values matching Xingtu packs: 0-1, 0-2, 0-3, 0-5, 0-10, 10-1000000.

expectedCpmRange.description: Expected CPM range in min-max format. Example values matching Xingtu packs: 0-10, 0-20, 0-30, 0-50, 0-100, 100-1000000.

expectedPlayRange.description: Expected play count range. Use raw counts in min-max format. Page presets include 10000000 or above, 5000000-10000000, 3000000-5000000, 1000000-3000000, 100000-1000000, and 0-100000. For open-ended presets, pass a high upper bound such as 10000000-1000000000. Example: 1000000-3000000.

progressTaskRange.description: In-progress task count range. Place a colon between the day count and the min-max range; omit either bound for an open range. Example: 30:8-

connectedUserRange.description: Connected user count range. Pass raw user counts in min-max format. Example: 1000000-3000000

completionRateRange.description: Completion rate range in decimal min-max format. Example values: 0.1-1 for 10% or above, 0.2-1 for 20% or above.

interactionRateRange.description: Interaction rate range in decimal min-max format. Example values: 0.01-1 for 1% or above, 0.02-1 for 2% or above.

readme:
# Douyin Xingtu Creator Search API

Search Douyin Creator Marketplace (Xingtu) creators by keyword and structured filters for audience, pricing, content, performance, and campaign fit. Use it to build and compare campaign shortlists.

The response is the platform's original data structure.

## Request

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.sandbase.ai/v1/api/douyin/xingtu-v3/gsearch-search-for-author-square" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SANDBASE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{}'
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `keyword` | string | No | Search keyword. |
| `page` | integer | No | Page number for pagination. |
| `sort` | string | No | Creator search sorting. Values: FANS sorts by follower count descending, DEFAULT uses Xingtu score ranking. |
| `searchType` | string | No | Search criteria type. |
| `marketingTarget` | string | No | Marketing goal. Available values: BRAND_EXPOSURE/1/品牌曝光, CIRCLE_SEEDING/2/破圈种草, ACTION_CONVERSION/3/行动转化. |
| `industry` | string | No | Recommended industry filter. Pass enum name, numeric industry ID, or Chinese industry label. Available values: - ALL/0/不限; - 1901: 3C及电器; - 1938: 购物; - 1903: 食品饮料; - 1904: 服装配饰; - 1905: 医药健康; - 1936: 医疗机构; - 1909: 家居建材; - 1907: 生活服务; - 1906: 商务服务; - 1921: 休闲娱乐; - 1937: 丽人; - 1908: 房地产; - 1910: 教育培训; - 1911: 出行旅游; - 1912: 社会公共; - 1913: 游戏; - 1914: 互联网电商服务; - 1915: 交通工具; - 1916: 汽车; - 1917: 农资园艺; - 1920: 机械设备; - 1939: 文化用品; - 1940: 运动户外; - 1922: 传媒资讯; - 1924: 通信; - 1925: 金融业; - 1927: 餐饮服务; - 1928: 工具类软件; - 1929: 招商加盟; - 1930: 美妆; - 1931: 母婴宠物; - 1933: 日化; - 1934: 实体书籍; - 1935: 社交通讯. |
| `isSuperstar` | boolean | No | Whether to filter celebrity creators. |
| `followerRange` | string | No | Raw follower count range in min-max format. Example: 1000-2000 means 1,000 to 2,000 followers; 5000000-10000000 means 5 million to 10 million followers. |
| `kolPriceType` | string | No | Creator quote type from the current Xingtu marketplace options. |
